Honest Review After My First Day of Wearing

I ordered Arcade (Althaïr Inspired) and Urban Pulse (Aventus Inspired).

Arcade was impressive from the first spray. It has a smooth, sweet, creamy gourmand profile that's very pleasant and enjoyable to wear. Since I haven't smelled the original Althaïr, I can't comment on how close it is, but as a fragrance on its own, I really like it.

Urban Pulse opens with a fresh citrus profile, but I personally notice a slight bitter note that remains even after the dry down. It's not overpowering, but it's noticeable to my nose. This could simply be my personal preference, as I tend to enjoy sweeter and smoother fragrances.

The packaging was good, and the customer support was responsive and answered all my questions before purchase.

Overall, I'm satisfied with the experience and will continue wearing both fragrances over the next few weeks to see how they develop.

Looking forward to trying more fragrances from the brand in the future.
